Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly inferred that the former Governor of Arkansas was Jim Guy Tucker based on a logical fallacy regarding the timeline of the Clinton administration. The WebSurfer correctly identified that Robert Suettinger served during the "Clinton administration" (1997-1998). The Planner erroneously assumed that because Bill Clinton was President, the "former Governor of Arkansas" he served under must be someone who served *before* Clinton (like Jim Guy Tucker), rather than recognizing that Bill Clinton himself was the former Governor of Arkansas who became President. The Planner failed to verify that the President of the United States is the same person who was previously the Governor of Arkansas, leading to the wrong answer of Jim Guy Tucker instead of William Jefferson Clinton.
